chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 557: Empyrean God Red Snow’s Seven Radiance God Crushes the Seamless Gate
chapter_meta_description: The Seven Radiance Empyrean God turns the tide of the Realm War. Daofather Crimsonbright secures Red Snow’s aid, while Wuxiao Celestial Immortal rushes a Daofather Puppet.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 557 — The Seven Radiance God Descends
og_description: Empyrean God Red Snow’s spacetime-shattering spear routs the Seamless Gate army. But victory is fragile, and a puppet master’s fury is building.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 557: Red Snow’s One-Time Favor That Saved a Realm
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s summoned Empyrean God devastates the battlefield, but the cost was a single fight. Crimsonbright scrambles to keep him… while Wuxiao forges a Daofather Puppet.

lore_anchors.definition: A colossal battle avatar formed from seven Empyrean Gods, creating a unified, spacetime-bending combat entity. Its effectiveness depends on the commander's skill.
A massive, brute-force war formation commanded by demon gods like the Nine-Headed Lion, representing raw, overwhelming power on the battlefield.
Three powerful demon gods—a Golden-Furred Divine Eagle, a Nine-Headed Lion, and their third brother—who can merge into the Three-Eyed Fiendgod formation.

Third brother of the Devouring Mountain Demon Gods and commander of the Three-Eyed Fiendgod; a powerful demon god whose Dao-insight nearly matches Empyrean God Red Snow but lacks his ancient combat experience.
A colossal battle avatar formed from hundreds of coordinated Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals, representing the concentrated might of an immortal army.
A supreme war puppet being forged in the Demonworld of Ten Thousand Demons, requiring 1.8 million Celestial Immortals to produce its components, overseen by Master Wuxiao.

The Seamless Gate's greatest master of the art of puppetry, whose true body is a puppet shell. He operates from the sealed Demonworld of Ten Thousand Demons and commands the forging of Daofather-tier war puppets.

A sealed, mysterious great world that serves as the true headquarters of the Seamless Gate’s puppet industry, hidden from even the Lord God of the Seamless Gate and operating under a higher authority.
Patriarch Bodhi’s ultimate supreme art; a path of cultivation so rare and profound that even touching its threshold grants a cultivator unparalleled stealth, mobility, and combat precision.
A horrific punishment threatened by Wuxiao Celestial Immortal against the millions of Celestial Immortals in the Demonworld if the Daofather Puppet is not completed on time.
